intro.speaker: Pip the Farmer
intro.text: Oh no, a wolf has kidnapped my pet chicken!

intro.speaker: Pip the Farmer
intro.text: Please — face it in battle and bring her home!

outro.speaker: Pip the Farmer
outro.text: You did it! Cluckers is safe and sound. Thank you!

intro.speaker: Grimble the Guide
intro.text: The old cellar has been overgrown for years — mushrooms and worse.

intro.speaker: Grimble the Guide
intro.text: Two of them guard the grain. Clear them out — carefully!

outro.speaker: Grimble the Guide
outro.text: Not a single spore left. The harvest is saved!

intro.speaker: Captain Rook
intro.text: A troll and its cronies have barred the only bridge out of the valley.

intro.speaker: Captain Rook
intro.text: Three of them. Scatter them and the road is ours again.

outro.speaker: Captain Rook
outro.text: The bridge is open. The valley owes you a debt, champion.
